units: <cite ref="Sanhedrin 49b:18">Snh. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>ח׳ בעלמא</he> a mere restrictive measure (which does not allow a conclusion as to the rank of the successive functions of the High-priest), <cite ref="Sanhedrin 49b:18">Ib.</cite> bot. <he>ומאי ח׳</he> wherein consists the greater import (the greater gravity of the crime)? <cite ref="Pesachim 11a:12">Pes. 11ᵃ</cite> <he>משום ח׳ דשבת וכ׳</he> on account of the great import of the Sabbath (the grave penalty for its desecration) people are careful &c.—

<cite ref="Chullin 9b:2">Ḥull. 9ᵇ</cite> <he>ספק סכנתא לח׳</he> where there is a doubt about a prohibition based on danger to health the stricter practice is preferred; <cite ref="Chullin 9b:2">ib.</cite> <he>ספק איסורא נמי לח׳</he> the same is the case with a doubt about a ritual prohibition.
<cite ref="Beitzah 3b">Bets. 3ᵇ</cite>; a. fr.—[Targ. II Esth. III, 3, v. <cite ref="H00810"><he>חֵימָרָא</he></cite>.]
